title: F5 and Oracle collaborate to strengthen application security in the AI era
summary: Collaboration is intended to help secure web applications and APIs against evolving cyber threats.
body_markdown:
**Collaboration is intended to help secure web applications and APIs against evolving cyber threats**


SEATTLE – F5 (NASDAQ: FFIV), a global leader in delivering and securing every app and API, and Oracle today announced a planned collaboration intended to bring next-generation web application and API protection (WAAP) to customers running applications on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Under the parties’ non-binding MOU, this planned collaboration is expected to help organizations protect critical applications and APIs against sophisticated attacks without adding complexity, slowing innovation, or requiring specialized security expertise.


“As cyber threats evolve, our customers need application and API protection that keeps pace without adding operational complexity,” said kp Papamiltiadis, senior vice president, global partnerships, Oracle. “Together, we plan to bring F5’s application security expertise into OCI, helping customers protect critical applications and APIs while simplifying security operations, backed by Oracle’s cloud infrastructure and support.”


The collaboration is intended to support these key benefits:


- Protect critical applications and APIs against sophisticated attacks: Is expected to help organizations address advanced threats with F5’s proven web application and API protection technology, without requiring specialized security expertise.
- Simplify security operations: Is expected to provide application and API protection, helping teams secure workloads within their familiar cloud environment without adding operational complexity.


“Applications and APIs are the foundation of modern enterprise innovation, but accelerating vulnerability discovery and AI-assisted threats present continuous challenges for cloud teams,” said John Maddison, chief marketing officer, F5. “Through the planned integration of F5’s application security technology into OCI, we intend to provide security, application, and platform teams with a proven, straightforward way to help protect their critical workloads with next-generation solutions powered by F5—without adding operational friction.”


For more information, visit[www.f5.com](https://www.f5.com/) and[www.oracle.com/cloud](https://www.oracle.com/cloud) .
